_comment: IDs are STABLE — never renumber or reuse. Removals set status:"removed" and keep the row.

entries.title: Login — OTP
entries.does: Phone-number entry that requests an OTP and verifies it via verify-otp to start a painter session.

entries.title: Phone Number Field
entries.does: 10-digit mobile number input validated before send-otp is called.

entries.title: OTP Verification
entries.does: 6-digit OTP input with a resend timer; verify-otp exchanges the code for a session token.

entries.title: Unregistered Number Redirect
entries.does: A phone number with no painter record redirects to Register instead of showing a login error.

entries.title: Register
entries.does: Collects new-painter details (name, phone, shop/branch, referral code) and submits the account for admin approval.

entries.title: Referral Deep-Link Prefill
entries.does: The code and phone query params from a shared referral link prefill the registration form.

entries.title: Registration Submit
entries.does: Submits the form to POST /register, which also fires a fire-and-forget Zoho customer sync.

entries.title: Awaiting Approval
entries.does: Holding screen shown after registration while an admin reviews the new painter account.

entries.title: Approval Status Poll
entries.does: Polls GET me/status to detect when an admin has approved the account and unlock the app.

entries.title: Request Approval Nudge
entries.does: Lets a painter stuck in review re-notify admins that their registration is pending.

entries.title: Onboarding
entries.does: First-run walkthrough shown once to a newly-approved painter before landing on Home.

entries.title: Intro Slides
entries.does: Swipeable carousel introducing the catalog, estimate creation, and points earning.

entries.title: Home
entries.does: Painter dashboard combining the earnings briefing, point balances, offers, catalog preview, and recent activity.
entries.navigatesTo: Catalog, Work — Estimates & Quotations, Profile (Me), Notifications, Quick Actions Sheet, Streak Sheet, Withdrawal Sheet

entries.title: Morning Briefing
entries.does: Gradient card showing earnings since the last visit, today's daily-bonus product, and level progress.

entries.title: Balance Tiles
entries.does: Displays the painter's regular and annual points balances.

entries.title: Offer Carousel
entries.does: Horizontal scroll of active point-boost offers on selected brands/categories.

entries.title: Level Panel
entries.does: Shows the painter's current loyalty tier (bronze/silver/gold/diamond) and progress to the next tier.

entries.title: Quick Actions Row
entries.does: Row of shortcut buttons (Check-in, Estimate, Withdraw, Refer) on the dashboard.

entries.title: Recent Estimates
entries.does: List of the painter's most recently created estimates, linking into Estimate Detail.

entries.title: Referral Section
entries.does: Shows the painter's referral code/link and referral count on the dashboard.

entries.title: Visualization Section
entries.does: Dashboard shortcut into requesting an AI room visualization.

entries.title: Bottom Navigation Bar
entries.does: Persistent bottom nav with Home/Work/Catalog/Profile tabs plus a center FAB that opens Quick Actions Sheet.
entries.navigatesTo: Home, Work — Estimates & Quotations, Catalog, Profile (Me), Quick Actions Sheet

entries.title: Navigation Graph
entries.does: Defines every screen route and its arguments for the painter app's single-activity Compose navigation host.

entries.title: Work — Estimates & Quotations
entries.does: Two-tab hub listing the painter's estimates and quotations.
entries.navigatesTo: Estimate Detail, Quotation Detail, Estimate Create — Billing Type, Quotation Create

entries.title: Estimates Tab
entries.does: Lists estimates with status badges; tapping a row opens Estimate Detail.

entries.title: Quotations Tab
entries.does: Lists quotations with status badges; tapping a row opens Quotation Detail.

entries.title: Status Badge
entries.does: Color-coded badge (draft/sent/approved/paid/etc.) shared by estimate and quotation rows.

entries.title: Empty Work State
entries.does: Shown when a painter has no estimates or quotations yet, with a CTA to create one.

entries.title: Catalog
entries.does: Browsable product grid with brand/category/points/offer/in-stock filters and an in-app cart.
entries.navigatesTo: Product Detail, Product Quick View Sheet, Cart Sheet — Self/Customer Chooser

entries.title: Catalog Product Card
entries.does: Grid card showing brand gradient, points/offer badges, shade selector, variant price chips, and Add-to-Cart.

entries.title: Catalog Filter Bar
entries.does: Search plus Brand/Category dropdowns and Points/Offers/In-Stock toggle chips.

entries.title: Cart Bottom Sheet Trigger
entries.does: Floating cart affordance that opens the Cart Sheet once at least one item is added.

entries.title: Product Request
entries.does: Lets a painter ask admins to add a product that is not in the catalog.

entries.title: Catalog Loading Shimmer
entries.does: Skeleton grid shown while the first page of catalog products is loading.

entries.title: Catalog Voice Search
entries.does: Microphone icon inside the search field for voice-based product search.

entries.title: Product Detail
entries.does: Full-screen product view with hero image, shade selector, pack-size/price variants, active offers, and a sticky Add-to-Cart CTA.

entries.title: Product Hero Header
entries.does: Brand-gradient hero image with product name, category, price range, and stock status.

entries.title: Product Shade Selector
entries.does: Colour-swatch row for products that have multiple shade variants.

entries.title: Product Variant Selector
entries.does: Pack-size chips exposing rate/MRP/points for the selected size and colour.

entries.title: Report Wrong Price
entries.does: Lets a painter flag a mismatched price with a proof photo for admin review.

entries.title: Out of Stock State
entries.does: Disables Add-to-Cart and shows an Out of Stock badge when total stock is zero.

entries.title: Product Quick View Sheet
entries.does: Modal bottom sheet preview of a product opened from the Catalog grid without leaving the grid.

entries.title: Offer Highlight Card
entries.does: Callout card showing the best active offer applicable to the product.

entries.title: Add to Estimate CTA
entries.does: Sticky bottom button that adds the selected variant straight into a new estimate.

entries.title: Estimate Create — Billing Type
entries.does: First step of estimate creation: choose whether the estimate bills the painter (self) or their customer.
entries.navigatesTo: Estimate Create — Products, Customer Estimate — Pricing & Review

entries.title: Self Billing Card
entries.does: Selects self-billing, where the painter is the invoiced customer and earns points directly.

entries.title: Customer Billing Card
entries.does: Selects customer-billing, where the estimate is priced for the painter's own customer.

entries.title: Estimate Wizard Step Indicator
entries.does: Progress indicator shown across the multi-step estimate-create wizard.

entries.title: Estimate Create — Products
entries.does: Second wizard step: search/filter products, pick pack sizes, and build the estimate's line items.
entries.navigatesTo: Estimate Create — Review (Self), Customer Estimate — Pricing & Review

entries.title: Estimate Filter Sheet
entries.does: Brand/category filter sheet scoped to the estimate-eligible product list.

entries.title: Estimate Pack Size Row
entries.does: Per-product pack-size rows with quantity steppers that build the cart.

entries.title: Estimate Cart Item Row
entries.does: Line items already added to the in-progress estimate, editable inline.

entries.title: Estimate Create — Review (Self)
entries.does: Final wizard step for self-billed estimates: review line items and totals before submitting.

entries.title: Estimate Totals Summary
entries.does: Subtotal, discount, and grand-total breakdown shown before submit.

entries.title: Submit Estimate
entries.does: Creates the estimate via POST me/estimates, guarded by an idempotency key.

entries.title: Customer Estimate — Pricing & Review
entries.does: Pricing and review screen for a customer-billed estimate built from the Cart; the painter sets customer-facing pricing before submit.

entries.title: Customer Line Row
entries.does: Per-item row where the painter can adjust the customer-facing rate for each product.

entries.title: Customer Details Form
entries.does: Captures the end-customer's name, phone, and address for the estimate.

entries.title: Quotation Create
entries.does: Five-step wizard (type, customer, rooms, pricing, preview) that builds a room-based painting quotation.

entries.title: Quotation Type Selection
entries.does: Chooses the quotation pricing model: salary, sqft-labour, sqft-material, or itemized.

entries.title: Quotation Customer Details
entries.does: Captures the customer's name, phone, and site address for the quotation.

entries.title: Quotation Room Entry
entries.does: Add rooms with dimensions to compute paintable area for the quotation.

entries.title: Quotation Pricing Step
entries.does: Applies the selected pricing model (salary/sqft-labour/sqft-material/itemized) to the entered rooms.

entries.title: Quotation Preview & Submit
entries.does: Final preview of the quotation before it is created.

entries.title: Quotation Detail
entries.does: Read view of a submitted quotation with customer, room, and pricing info plus status.

entries.title: Quotation Info Card
entries.does: Customer details, quotation type, and status badge.

entries.title: Send Quotation
entries.does: Marks the quotation as sent to the customer.

entries.title: Edit / Delete Quotation
entries.does: Lets the painter edit a draft quotation or delete it before it has been sent.

entries.title: Quotation Room & Pricing Summary
entries.does: Read-only breakdown of the rooms and pricing captured during Quotation Create.

entries.title: Estimate Detail
entries.does: Read view of a single estimate: customer/billing info, line items, totals, and balance due.

entries.title: Estimate Info Card
entries.does: Billing type, customer info, and estimate status.

entries.title: Estimate Items Section
entries.does: Line-item list with quantities, rates, and points earned per item.

entries.title: Estimate Totals Card
entries.does: Subtotal, discount, paid, and balance-due summary.

entries.title: Submit to Admin / Request Discount
entries.does: Escalates the estimate for admin approval or a discount beyond the painter's own limit.

entries.title: Delete Draft Estimate
entries.does: Deletes an estimate that has not yet been submitted.

entries.title: Estimate PDF Preview
entries.does: Renders and previews the estimate as a PDF, with a share action.

entries.title: Share Estimate PDF
entries.does: Shares the generated estimate PDF via the Android share sheet.

entries.title: Payment Sheet
entries.does: Bottom sheet for recording a payment against an estimate, opened from Estimate Detail.

entries.title: Payment Amount Field
entries.does: Amount and payment-mode input, validated against the remaining balance due.

entries.title: Record Payment
entries.does: Submits the payment, guarded by an idempotency key, and refreshes the estimate balance.

entries.title: Check-In (Selfie Attendance)
entries.does: Selfie plus GPS attendance check-in matched against the nearest branch geofence.

entries.title: Nearby Branch Detection
entries.does: Finds candidate branches within geofence range of the device's current location.

entries.title: Selfie Capture
entries.does: Captures a selfie photo required alongside GPS for the check-in submission.

entries.title: Check-In Permission Denied
entries.does: Shown when camera or location permission is refused, with a rationale and a settings deep-link.

entries.title: Today's Check-In Status
entries.does: Shows whether the painter has already checked in today.

entries.title: Attendance Calendar
entries.does: Monthly calendar view marking which days the painter checked in.

entries.title: Attendance Calendar Grid
entries.does: Month grid highlighting the days the painter checked in.

entries.title: Attendance History
entries.does: Chronological, month-grouped list of past check-ins with a checked-in count per month.

entries.title: Attendance Month Header
entries.does: Per-month header showing the checked-in count out of total days.

entries.title: Paint Calculator
entries.does: Room-by-room paint quantity and coverage calculator that can convert results straight into a quotation.

entries.title: Calculator Room Input Card
entries.does: Per-room dimension entry (length/width/height, doors/windows) used to compute paintable area.

entries.title: Calculator Results View
entries.does: Shows computed litres/coverage per selected paint and lets the painter save the calculation.

entries.title: Convert to Quotation
entries.does: Passes calculator results into the Quotation Create room-entry step.

entries.title: Notifications
entries.does: List of push notifications (streak, level-up, daily bonus, approvals) with read/unread state.

entries.title: Notification Row
entries.does: Icon-coded row per notification type; tapping a row marks it read.

entries.title: Profile (Me)
entries.does: Painter's own profile hub: header stats and points, plus a menu into the rewards/training/social screens.
entries.navigatesTo: Edit Profile, Cards (Rewards), Visualizations, Referrals, Leaderboard, Achievements, Training, Settings

entries.title: Profile Header
entries.does: Avatar, name, and level badge with an edit shortcut.

entries.title: Profile Points Columns
entries.does: Side-by-side regular vs annual points totals.

entries.title: Profile Menu Grid
entries.does: Quick-action and menu cards linking to Cards, Visualize, Referrals, Leaderboard, Achievements, Training, Points History, Gallery, and Settings.

entries.title: Edit Profile
entries.does: Edit form for the painter's name, shop details, and profile photo.

entries.title: Profile Photo Upload
entries.does: Replaces the profile photo shown on cards and the app header.

entries.title: Gallery
entries.does: Grid of work-sample photos the painter has uploaded, with add/delete.
entries.api: GET me/gallery, POST me/gallery, DELETE me/gallery/:id

entries.title: Upload Gallery Photo
entries.does: Adds a new work-sample photo to the gallery.

entries.title: Referrals
entries.does: Shows the painter's referral code/link, referral count, and per-referral status list.

entries.title: Referral Stat Cards
entries.does: Summary counts (invited, registered, active) for the painter's referrals.

entries.title: Referral Row
entries.does: Per-referred-painter row with name and registration/activation status.

entries.title: Leaderboard
entries.does: Ranks painters by points, with a podium view for the top 3.

entries.title: Leaderboard Top 3 Podium
entries.does: Medal-styled podium cards for the top 3 ranked painters.

entries.title: Leaderboard Row
entries.does: Ranked row for painters outside the top 3, highlighting the current painter's own position.

entries.title: Achievements
entries.does: Badge grid of gamification achievements plus level progress toward the next tier.

entries.title: Achievements Level Progress Card
entries.does: Current level and total points with a progress bar to the next tier.

entries.title: Achievement Badge Card
entries.does: Individual achievement badge, locked or unlocked, with a claim action for challenge rewards.

entries.title: Training
entries.does: List of training videos/articles for painters, with a featured video at the top.

entries.title: Featured Training Video Card
entries.does: Highlighted training video shown with a YouTube thumbnail.

entries.title: Training List Card
entries.does: Row per training item, linking through to Training Detail.

entries.title: Training Detail
entries.does: Full view of a single training item, either an embedded video or article-style content.

entries.title: Training Content Viewer
entries.does: Renders either an embedded video player or article text depending on the training item's type.

entries.title: Points History
entries.does: Chronological ledger of point-earning and point-spending transactions with a tier-progress track.

entries.title: Points Tier Progress Track
entries.does: Visual progress bar across the bronze/silver/gold/diamond thresholds.

entries.title: Points Transaction Row
entries.does: Per-transaction row with a source icon (invoice, referral, bonus, clawback) and amount.

entries.title: Cards (Rewards)
entries.does: Generated visiting-card and ID-card images for the painter, with a share action.

entries.title: Card Section
entries.does: Renders the visiting-card or ID-card image returned by the server.

entries.title: Share Card
entries.does: Shares the card image via the Android share sheet.

entries.title: Visualizations
entries.does: Requests and reviews AI room-visualization renders (a room photo repainted with a selected colour).

entries.title: Visualization Request Form Sheet
entries.does: Upload a room photo and pick a colour to request a new visualization render.

entries.title: Visualization Status Cards
entries.does: Status cards for in-progress and completed visualization requests.

entries.title: Visualization Full-Screen Viewer
entries.does: Full-screen zoomable view of a completed visualization render.

entries.title: Settings
entries.does: App preferences (notification toggles) plus account info and logout.
entries.api: POST me/fcm/register, DELETE me/fcm/unregister, POST logout

entries.title: Notification Toggle
entries.does: Switch controlling push-notification opt-in/out, wired to FCM token register/unregister.

entries.title: Settings App Info Row
entries.does: Read-only app version / build info row.

entries.title: Logout
entries.does: Clears the local painter session and returns to Login.

entries.title: Quick Actions Sheet
entries.does: Modal bottom sheet opened from the bottom-nav center FAB, offering shortcuts to start an estimate, quotation, check-in, or calculator.
entries.navigatesTo: Estimate Create — Billing Type, Quotation Create, Check-In (Selfie Attendance), Paint Calculator

entries.title: Quick Action Tile
entries.does: Each tile navigates to its target flow and dismisses the sheet on tap.

entries.title: Cart Sheet — Self/Customer Chooser
entries.does: Reviews items added to the in-app cart from Catalog and proceeds into the self-vs-customer billing choice.

entries.title: Cart Row
entries.does: Per-item row with quantity increment/decrement and remove controls.

entries.title: Cart Create Estimate Button
entries.does: Proceeds from the cart into the estimate-create wizard's billing-type step.

entries.title: Streak Sheet
entries.does: Calendar bottom sheet on Home showing the painter's daily check-in streak and milestone bonuses.

entries.title: Streak Calendar
entries.does: Monthly grid marking which days the painter checked in for the streak.

entries.title: Streak Milestone Markers
entries.does: Highlights the 3/7/14/30-day streak milestone bonuses (50/150/300/1000 pts).

entries.title: Withdrawal Sheet
entries.does: Bottom sheet for requesting a withdrawal of earned points/cash and viewing past withdrawal requests.

entries.title: Withdraw Amount Field
entries.does: Amount input validated against the painter's available balance.

entries.title: Withdrawal Request Submit
entries.does: Submits the withdrawal request, guarded by an idempotency key.

entries.title: Withdrawal History
entries.does: List of past withdrawal requests with status.
